Florida Keys

Start with the experience.

The Keys offer distinct flats, backcountry and offshore experiences. The tourism directory lists tarpon, bonefish and permit among flats targets, and mahi, sailfish and tuna offshore.

When should you go?

Choose your target first, then ask a local captain which dates fit. This starter guide does not publish a target-specific monthly catch forecast.

What to sort out first.

Confirm the actual departure island, trip style, shade, equipment and passenger capacity. A listing somewhere in the Keys is not necessarily close to your accommodation.

Build the checklist with your dates and fishing style. Mark equipment as provided only after confirmation, and use your own suitable gear before considering another purchase.

Sources & coverage

Source-reviewed starter guide · September 13, 2026. Not field-tested or a live conditions report. Planning advice is editorial; confirm trip details locally.
